title: pikku-inspect --stdin input
description: What @pikku/inspector-go writes to the stdin of `pikku-inspect --stdin`. Mirrors InspectorGoInput in src/protocol.ts.

routeFiles.description: Absolute paths of the source files to inspect.

options.description: The InspectorOptions analysis reads (InspectorGoAnalysisOptions). Everything else is consumed by finalize on the TypeScript side. Unset options are omitted.

tsconfig.description: Absolute path of the tsconfig the program is built from.

rootDir.description: Absolute project root; files outside it are not swept.

setupOnly.description: Run only the setup sweep (factories, wireAddon, config), skipping functions, routes and schemas.

openAPI.description: Read by the Go finalize only: InspectorOptions.openAPI. When set, finalize generates the OpenAPI spec.

manifest.description: Read by the Go finalize only: the versions.pikku.json contents (InspectorOptions.manifest).

modelAliases.description: Read by the Go finalize only: the "models" table of pikku.config.json, alias -> provider/model.

strictMeta.description: Read by the Go finalize only: report agent tools without a description.

types.description: Type names the user configured in pikku.config.json.

schemaConfig.description: Present when JSON schemas are generated from the function types.

vendorScript.description: The Node script that converts Zod schemas to JSON Schema.

isAddon.description: The project is an addon, so transports and some contracts are banned.

classificationCheck.description: Require every function to declare a data classification.
